history.idea: Replace random order with a target-similarity filter. (1) Fit a TfidfVectorizer on character n-grams (analyzer='char_wb', ngram_range=(1,3), sublinear_tf=True, max_features=50000) using the first 3000 chars of each pool doc plus target_sample; train a LogisticRegression (C=1, class_weight='balanced') with the 200 target_sample docs as positives and a seeded random 3000 pool docs as negatives; score every pool doc by predicted probability. Add a cheap boost feature for WikiText formatting: +bonus if the doc starts with '= ' and contains ' @-@ ' or ' , ' tokenised punctuation. (2) Exact-deduplicate by hash of whitespace-normalised text (keep first copy), and drop docs under 200 chars. (3) Rank docs by score, count tokens with tiktoken gpt2 (encode_ordinary_batch), and keep the top-scoring docs until the kept set reaches T tokens or the score drops below 0.5, whichever comes first (if fewer than T tokens pass, just return that smaller set and let the trainer cycle it rather than padding with off-domain text). (4) Return kept indices in a CURATE_SEED-seeded shuffled order.
